name: Géoplateforme elevation (IGN France, cartes.gouv.fr)
x-note: WMS-Raster of data.geopf.fr (WMS 1.3.0, so EPSG:4326 boxes are latitude first); layers and the image/geotiff format checked against the live GetCapabilities and GetMap on 2026-11-21 (32-bit float heights, NoData -99999 or -9999, MaxWidth/MaxHeight 5010, 40 requests/s per IP, no key). Heights are altitudes in NGF-IGN69 (IGN78 in Corsica). Datasets are fetched at the resolution given here, which the server resamples to. LiDAR HD covers most but not yet all of France: missing parts come back as NoData. Licence Ouverte 2.0 from each dataset's catalogue record; recheck before release.
